theorySlides.title: React Hooks 🪝
theorySlides.content:
Built-in hooks:
• **useState**: Local state
• **useEffect**: Side effects
• **useContext**: Consume context
• **useRef**: Mutable refs
• **useMemo/useCallback**: Optimization

theorySlides.title: Rules of Hooks 📏
theorySlides.content:
Two rules you MUST follow:

1️⃣ **Only call at top level** - Not inside loops, conditions, or nested functions

2️⃣ **Only call from React functions** - Components or custom hooks

theorySlides.title: useEffect Cleanup
Dependency Array ⚙️
theorySlides.content:
Controls when effect runs:

• **[]** - Only on mount
• **[dep]** - When dep changes
• **No array** - Every render (careful!)

Always include all values used inside effect.

questions.question: When does useEffect cleanup run?
questions.explanation: Cleanup runs before re-running effect and on unmount.

questions.question: What does an empty dependency array [] mean?
questions.explanation: Empty array means effect runs only once when component mounts.

questions.question: Can you use hooks inside if statements?
options: No, must be at top level
questions.explanation: Hooks must be called at the top level to ensure consistent order between renders.

theorySlides.title: Custom Hooks 🔧
theorySlides.content:
Extract reusable logic:
• Start with "use" prefix
• Can use other hooks inside
• Share stateful logic, not state

theorySlides.title: Example: useLocalStorage

questions.question: Custom hook naming convention?
questions.explanation: Custom hooks must start with "use" prefix.

theorySlides.title: React Context 🌐
theorySlides.content:
Share data without passing props:
• createContext(): Create context
• Provider: Provide value
• useContext(): Consume value

theorySlides.title: Context Pattern

questions.question: What does useContext return?
questions.explanation: useContext returns the current value from nearest Provider.

theorySlides.title: React Performance ⚡
theorySlides.content:
Prevent unnecessary re-renders:
• **React.memo**: Memoize components
• **useMemo**: Memoize values
• **useCallback**: Memoize functions

theorySlides.title: When to Optimize

questions.question: When does useMemo recalculate?
questions.explanation: useMemo only recalculates when dependencies change.

theorySlides.title: Error Boundaries 🛡️
theorySlides.content:
Catch JavaScript errors in components:
• Prevents whole app crash
• Shows fallback UI
• Class component only (for now)

theorySlides.title: Error Boundary Class

questions.question: What errors do boundaries NOT catch?
questions.explanation: Error boundaries dont catch event handler errors - use try/catch.
